# XFree.in — Free Developer, SEO & AI Micro-Tools

> XFree.in publishes focused browser-based developer utilities, technical SEO tools, formatters, converters, and clearly disclosed AI assistants.

## Primary Sections

- [Home](https://www.xfree.in/): Search and browse the published tool directory.
- [Guides](https://www.xfree.in/guides): Reviewed documentation connected to published tools.
- [How It Works](https://www.xfree.in/how-it-works): Processing modes, browser execution, and optional cloud handoffs.
- [Pillars](https://www.xfree.in/pillars): 50 developer and SEO topic pillars; only pillars backed by published tools enter the sitemap.
- [Roadmap](https://www.xfree.in/roadmap): 25,000 planned concepts on a noindex discovery page; this is not a count of live tools.
- [Contribute](https://www.xfree.in/contribute): Open-source contribution workflow, publication gates, and safe good-first-issue process.
- [InstaServer](https://www.xfree.in/instaserver): Free, open-source MCP server that deploys app containers on your own machine — no account, no rate limit.
- [JSON Tools](https://www.xfree.in/json-tools): Hub of 18 free browser-based JSON tools — format, validate, minify, convert, sort, and inspect.
- [OpenAPI](https://www.xfree.in/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of the public XFree API surface.

## Categories

- [SEO & URL Tools](https://www.xfree.in/seo-tools): Bulk extraction, XML sitemaps, Meta OpenGraph previews, Robots.txt, and Schema markup
- [Developer Tools](https://www.xfree.in/developer-tools): Format, validate, diff, and convert JSON, XML, YAML, Regex, Cron, JWT, and SQL
- [Text & Diff Tools](https://www.xfree.in/text-tools): Text diffing, line sorting, word count, slugifier, and regex replacements
- [Converters & Encoders](https://www.xfree.in/converters): Base64, URL encoding, Unix Timestamps, Color space conversion, and CSS units
- [Generators](https://www.xfree.in/generators): UUID v4, Cron schedules, Hash generation (SHA-256/MD5), and UTM campaign links
- [Validators](https://www.xfree.in/validators): Validate JSON, XML, sitemaps, Schema.org markup, robots.txt rules, and structured data with focused browser-based checks.

## Published Pillars

- [Technical SEO](https://www.xfree.in/pillar/technical-seo): Search engine crawlability, schema validation, URL hygiene, and indexing diagnostics.
- [System Administration](https://www.xfree.in/pillar/system-administration): Cron expression generators, bash script linters, and Linux permission calculators.
- [Regular Expressions (Regex)](https://www.xfree.in/pillar/regular-expressions-regex): Regex testing, pattern visualizers, and escape string generators.
- [Cryptography & Hashing](https://www.xfree.in/pillar/cryptography-hashing): SHA-256/512 generators, HMAC calculators, and AES client encryptors.
- [JSON, XML & YAML Utils](https://www.xfree.in/pillar/json-xml-yaml-utils): Bi-directional serialization, schema validation, and path extractors.

## Published Tools

- [XML Sitemap Generator & Validator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/xml-sitemap-generator): Generate valid Google & Bing XML sitemaps with priority, changefreq, lastmod, and automatic chunking for large link sets.
- [Robots.txt Generator & User-Agent Rule Tester](https://www.xfree.in/tools/robots-txt-generator): Create valid robots.txt directives for search engine crawlers, test path allowance rules, and specify XML sitemaps.
- [Meta Tag & Open Graph Social Card Preview](https://www.xfree.in/tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate meta title tags, meta descriptions, and Open Graph / Twitter Cards with real-time Google SERP and social card previews.
- [Schema Markup Generator (JSON-LD Structured Data)](https://www.xfree.in/tools/schema-markup-generator): Generate valid Schema.org JSON-LD structured data for WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, Article, and Breadcrumbs.
- [JSON / XML Formatter, Validator & Tree Viewer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, repair, minify, and inspect JSON/XML data with interactive tree views and error location diagnostics.
- [Regex Tester & Interactive Match Explainer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions live with match group breakdown, string replacement previews, and flags (g, i, m).
- [Bulk URL Extractor & Sitemap Generator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/bulk-url-extractor): Extract URLs from massive raw text or HTML, clean, deduplicate, filter by domain, and generate valid XML Sitemaps with Sitemap-Index splitting.
- [Cron Expression Generator & Human Translator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/cron-expression-generator): Generate standard 5-part cron schedule expressions, view plain-English explanations, and calculate upcoming execution times.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder & JWT Token Inspector](https://www.xfree.in/tools/base64-encoder-decoder): Safely encode and decode Base64 strings, UTF-8 text, Base64URL parameters, and inspect OAuth JWT headers, payloads, and claims.
- [URL Slug Generator & Campaign UTM Parameter Builder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/url-slug-utm-builder): Clean title strings into SEO-friendly URL slugs, and build campaign URLs with UTM parameters (source, medium, campaign, term, content).
- [SIP & EMI Calculator — Mutual Fund & Loan EMI](https://www.xfree.in/tools/sip-emi-calculator): Calculate SIP mutual fund maturity value with a year-by-year growth breakdown, and EMI loan repayment with a full amortization schedule.
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-to-csv-converter): Convert JSON arrays or objects into consistently quoted CSV for spreadsheets, data review, imports, and local pipeline preparation.
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/csv-to-json-converter): Parse quoted CSV with a header row into structured JSON objects for APIs, fixtures, analysis, and browser-side data cleanup.
- [Base64 Text Encoder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/base64-text-encoder): Encode Unicode text into standard Base64 using UTF-8 bytes for transport, test fixtures, configuration, and payload inspection.
- [Base64 Text Decoder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/base64-text-decoder): Decode standard Base64 into UTF-8 text locally for inspecting payloads, configuration values, tokens, and encoded snippets.
- [URL Component Encoder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/url-component-encoder): Percent-encode text as a URL component so reserved characters can safely appear inside query values, fragments, or generated links.
- [URL Component Decoder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/url-component-decoder): Decode percent-encoded URL component text to inspect human-readable query values, slugs, redirect parameters, and tracking data.
- [UTF-8 Hex Encoder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/utf8-hex-encoder): Encode Unicode text into lowercase UTF-8 hexadecimal byte pairs for debugging protocol payloads, storage formats, and byte boundaries.
- [UTF-8 Hex Decoder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/utf8-hex-decoder): Decode hexadecimal byte pairs as strict UTF-8 text for inspecting encoded payloads, serialized values, and protocol samples.
- [HTML Entity Encoder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/html-entity-encoder): Escape HTML-significant characters so text can be displayed literally instead of being interpreted as markup by an HTML parser.
- [HTML Entity Decoder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/html-entity-decoder): Decode common named and numeric HTML entities into readable Unicode text without evaluating the decoded result as executable markup.
- [JSON Pretty Printer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-pretty-printer): Parse valid JSON and pretty-print it with consistent indentation for debugging, code review, documentation, and version-control friendly diffs.
- [JSON Minifier](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-minifier): Remove insignificant JSON whitespace by parsing and reserializing valid JSON for compact transport, fixtures, and embedded configuration.
- [JSON Key Sorter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-key-sorter): Sort JSON object keys recursively while preserving array order to make configuration snapshots, reviews, and structural diffs easier to compare.
- [JSON Syntax Validator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-syntax-validator): Validate whether input is syntactically correct JSON with an immediate browser-side pass result or parser error for malformed documents.
- [JSON Value Type Inspector](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-value-type-inspector): Identify the top-level JSON value type to distinguish objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and null during payload inspection.
- [JSON Object Key Extractor](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-object-key-extractor): List the top-level keys of a JSON object for schema discovery, payload auditing, fixture review, and quick field inventory checks.
- [JSON Array Length Counter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-array-length-counter): Count entries in a top-level JSON array without manually scanning a collection or uploading the payload to a remote processing service.
- [JSON Pointer Resolver](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-pointer-resolver): Resolve an RFC 6901-style JSON Pointer against a JSON document to inspect a precise nested value in the browser without server code.
- [JSON Array Deduplicator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-array-deduplicator): Remove repeated values from a top-level JSON array by comparing their serialized representation for deterministic browser-side cleanup.
- [JSON Array Sorter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-array-sorter): Sort a homogeneous top-level JSON array of strings or numbers for predictable review, fixtures, comparisons, and local data preparation.
- [JSON String Escaper](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-string-escaper): Serialize arbitrary text as one valid JSON string literal with quotes, line breaks, controls, and backslashes escaped correctly.
- [JSON String Unescaper](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-string-unescaper): Parse one valid JSON string literal and recover the underlying Unicode text for debugging escaped API values and serialized configuration.
- [JSON Lines to Array Converter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/jsonl-to-json-array): Convert newline-delimited JSON records into one standard JSON array for APIs, analysis, fixtures, and spreadsheet conversion workflows.
- [JSON Array to JSON Lines Converter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-array-to-jsonl): Serialize each element of a top-level JSON array as one JSON Lines record for streaming, logs, import pipelines, and line-oriented tooling.
- [JSON Nesting Depth Calculator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/json-nesting-depth-calculator): Calculate the nesting depth of JSON objects and arrays to spot deeply nested payloads that can be difficult to inspect, transform, or validate.
- [Text Case Converter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/text-case-converter): Convert text to upper, lower, or title-style case and inspect basic word and character counts with one local browser utility.
- [Text to URL Slug Generator](https://www.xfree.in/tools/text-to-url-slug-generator): Turn titles and labels into lowercase ASCII hyphenated slugs for clean paths, filenames, anchors, and stable content identifiers.
- [Duplicate Line Remover](https://www.xfree.in/tools/duplicate-line-remover): Remove exact duplicate lines while preserving first occurrence order for lists, exports, keyword sets, logs, and configuration fragments.
- [Alphabetical Line Sorter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/alphabetical-line-sorter): Sort newline-separated text with the browser locale comparator for cleaner lists, reports, configuration files, and review workflows.
- [Whitespace Normalizer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/whitespace-normalizer): Trim text and collapse runs of spaces, tabs, and line breaks into single spaces for compact comparison, cleanup, and normalization tasks.
- [Empty Line Remover](https://www.xfree.in/tools/empty-line-remover): Remove blank and whitespace-only lines while preserving the content and order of every non-empty line in the source text.
- [Line Order Reverser](https://www.xfree.in/tools/line-order-reverser): Reverse the order of lines without reversing characters inside each line for lists, chronological notes, logs, and stack-like data.
- [Unicode Character Counter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/unicode-character-counter): Count UTF-16 code units and Unicode code points to understand how browsers and Unicode-aware systems measure a text string.
- [Unicode Code Point Counter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/unicode-code-point-counter): Count Unicode code points without confusing supplementary characters with two UTF-16 code units during browser-side text inspection.
- [Grapheme Cluster Counter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/grapheme-cluster-counter): Count user-perceived grapheme clusters with Intl.Segmenter for realistic text limits involving international characters and emoji sequences.
- [Unicode Word Counter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/unicode-word-counter): Count practical Unicode word tokens for drafts, documentation, snippets, and content checks without uploading the working text.
- [Sentence Counter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/sentence-counter): Estimate sentence count from terminal punctuation for quick draft checks, documentation review, and lightweight readability workflows.
- [Paragraph Counter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/paragraph-counter): Count text blocks separated by blank lines to inspect document structure, drafts, notes, and content without sending it to a server.
- [Character Frequency Analyzer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/character-frequency-analyzer): Count occurrences of each Unicode code point to inspect symbol distribution, separators, repeated characters, and unusual text patterns.
- [Word Frequency Analyzer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/word-frequency-analyzer): Count normalized practical word tokens to reveal repeated terminology, dominant vocabulary, and simple text distribution patterns locally.
- [Unicode Text Reverser](https://www.xfree.in/tools/unicode-text-reverser): Reverse text by Unicode code point for transformation testing, puzzles, fixtures, and string-processing experiments in the browser.
- [Word Order Reverser](https://www.xfree.in/tools/word-order-reverser): Reverse whitespace-delimited word order while preserving characters inside each token for quick text transformation and test preparation.
- [Line Whitespace Trimmer](https://www.xfree.in/tools/line-whitespace-trimmer): Remove leading and trailing whitespace from every line while preserving line order and internal spacing for controlled text cleanup.
- [Line Prefix Adder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/line-prefix-adder): Add one shared prefix to every line for comments, bullets, log labels, generated configuration, and batch text preparation workflows.
- [Line Suffix Adder](https://www.xfree.in/tools/line-suffix-adder): Append one shared suffix to every line for delimiters, annotations, generated code fragments, and repetitive batch editing workflows.
- [Line Numbering Tool](https://www.xfree.in/tools/line-numbering-tool): Prefix each line with a one-based number for reviews, checklists, snippets, transcripts, instructions, and manual reference workflows.
- [Line Include Filter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/line-include-filter): Keep only lines containing an exact substring for quick log triage, keyword filtering, exports, lists, and configuration cleanup.
- [Matching Line Remover](https://www.xfree.in/tools/matching-line-remover): Remove lines containing an exact substring while preserving every non-matching line in its original order for controlled cleanup.
- [Tabs to Spaces Converter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/tabs-to-spaces-converter): Replace tab characters with a configurable number of spaces for code review, data cleanup, indentation checks, and formatting normalization.
- [Leading Spaces to Tabs Converter](https://www.xfree.in/tools/leading-spaces-to-tabs): Convert groups of leading spaces into tab characters using a chosen indentation width while leaving internal spacing untouched.

## Workflow Recipes

- [Workflow Recipes](https://www.xfree.in/recipes): Versioned, deterministic local workflows composed from allowlisted XFree engines.
- [URL Cleanup Pipeline](https://www.xfree.in/recipes/url-cleanup-pipeline): Extract HTTP(S) URLs, normalize each URL, remove duplicates, sort the list, and export a JSON array.
- [Log Sanitizer](https://www.xfree.in/recipes/log-sanitizer): Trim log lines, keep ERROR lines, deduplicate repeated errors, sort them, and emit structured JSON.
- [JWT Inspection Workflow](https://www.xfree.in/recipes/jwt-inspection-workflow): Decode a JWT without verifying its signature, format the decoded JSON, and sort object keys for inspection.
- [SEO URL Audit](https://www.xfree.in/recipes/seo-url-audit): Extract and normalize links, deduplicate them, then classify URLs by the origin of the first extracted URL.
- [JSON API Cleanup](https://www.xfree.in/recipes/json-api-cleanup): Validate JSON, format it, and recursively sort object keys into a stable review-friendly representation.
- [Text Cleanup Pipeline](https://www.xfree.in/recipes/text-cleanup-pipeline): Trim lines, remove blanks, deduplicate repeated lines, sort the result, and count words without changing final text.
- [CSV Preparation](https://www.xfree.in/recipes/csv-preparation): Parse CSV into structured JSON, then serialize it back into consistently quoted CSV for a deterministic cleanup pass.
- [Developer Clipboard Cleanup](https://www.xfree.in/recipes/developer-clipboard-cleanup): Pull URL-shaped values out of noisy terminal or CI output, deduplicate and sort them, then export JSON.
